about: T76's one hand-written input to the catalogue: for each demo, keyed by its make target, its name, the known game it is like (the owner's rule: build on games people already know) and the keys that show its AI deciding -- each in English and pt-BR, the keys held to the target's make help line; and a short name in both languages for each algorithm the menu's cards (godot/menu/catalogue.json) list. Which techniques and algorithms a demo uses is never written here: scripts/catalogue.py measures it from modules/*.json, the cards and the code its scene reaches. verified_on is the day someone last opened the demos and checked these lines against them; the catalogue pages carry it.
